audiocpp_cli --task <task> --family <family> --model <path> --backend <backend> [options]
  Global:
    --task vad|asr|diar|sep|gen|tts|clon|vc|s2s|align|vdes|spk|svc|midi
    --family <name>
    --model <path>
    --backend cpu|cuda|hip|rocm|vulkan|metal|best  (rocm is an alias for hip)
    --mode offline|streaming  default offline
    --device <n>
    --list-devices  List available backend devices and exit
    --threads <n>  Backend and OpenMP worker threads, default 4
    --registry-config <path>
    --model-spec-override <json-or-directory>  Override package-spec resolution
    --config <id>
    --weight <id>
    --log  Stream framework progress and timing logs to stdout
    --log-file <path>  Stream framework progress and timing logs to a file
    --metrics  Print compact wall time, audio duration, and RTF summary after offline generation
    --load-option key=value
    --session-option key=value
    --request-option key=value
  Batch:
    --request-sequence <json>  Run JSON requests in one offline session
    --batch-text-file <txt>  Run one offline request per non-empty line
    --batch-text-dir <dir>  Run one offline request per .txt, .md, or .json file
    --batch-audio-dir <dir>  Run one offline request per .wav file
    --batch-audio-role audio|voice_ref|source_audio|target_voice|prosody_ref|style_ref
    --batch-merge-audio none|concat
    --batch-manifest-out <json>
    Shared CLI inputs and options are defaults for --batch-text-file, --batch-text-dir, and --batch-audio-dir
  Pipelines:
    --pipeline <json>  Run a JSON app workflow instead of a raw task
    --list-pipelines
    --workflow-input key=value  Override a top-level workflow input
    --audio-converter <cmd>  Converter executable for workflow media import, default ffmpeg
  Task routing and media roles:
    --task-route <name>  User-facing route, e.g. text2music, zero_shot_tts, style_preserved_vc
    --source-audio <wav>  Source audio path for models that take path-based source refs
    --target-voice <wav>  Target/timbre voice path for path-based voice conversion
    --prosody-ref <wav>
    --style-ref <wav>
    --target-text <text>
    --style-ref-text <text>
    --use-prosody-code true|false
    --predict-target-prosody true|false
    --use-pitch-shift true|false
    --source-shift-steps <n>
    --prosody-shift-steps <n>
    --style-shift-steps <n>
    --target-duration-seconds <float>
    --reference-duration-seconds <float>
    --lyrics <text>
    --track-name <name>
    --speaker <name>
    --duration-seconds <float>
    --repaint-start <float>
    --repaint-end <float>
    --repaint-mode <name>
    --repaint-strength <float>
  Common generation:
    --seed <n>
    --max-tokens <n>
    --max-steps <n>
    --temperature <float>
    --top-k <n>
    --top-p <float>
    --repetition-penalty <float>
    --do-sample true|false
    --num-beams <n>
    --guidance-scale <float>
    --num-inference-steps <n>
    --text-chunk-size <chars>
    --text-chunk-mode default|tag_aware|japanese|endline
  Inputs:
    --audio <wav>  Use - to stream raw PCM from stdin (requires --mode streaming)
    --input-format s16le|f32le  Raw PCM sample format for --audio -, default s16le
    --input-rate <hz>  Raw PCM sample rate for --audio -, default 16000
    --input-channels <n>  Raw PCM channel count for --audio -, default 1
    --text <text>
    --max-text-length <chars>  Maximum input text length for models that enforce it
    --language <code>
    --voice-id <id>
    --voice-ref <wav>
    --reference-text <text>  Reference transcript for voice-clone models such as Qwen3 TTS
    --instruct <text>  Voice-design instruction for models such as Qwen3 TTS
    --style-language <code>
    --emotion <name>
    --speaking-rate <float>
    --pitch-shift <float>
    --energy-scale <float>
    --style-tag key=value
  Outputs:
    --out <file>
    --out-dir <dir>  Write named multi-audio outputs or batch request outputs
    --text-out <txt>
    --segments-out <json>
    --vad-chunks-out <json>  Write offline VAD-based chunk windows
    --vad-chunk-max-seconds <float>  Maximum VAD chunk length, default 45
    --vad-chunk-merge-gap-seconds <float>  Merge nearby VAD spans, default 0.5
    --vad-chunk-padding-seconds <float>  Pad each VAD span before chunking, default 0.25
    --turns-out <json>
    --words-out <json>
    --voice-state-out <safetensors>  Export PocketTTS voice state from --voice-ref
  Streaming:
    --mode streaming uses the selected model's default streaming policy
  Utility:
    --inspect
    --list-loaders [--json]

  Tasks:
    vad    voice activity detection
    asr    automatic speech recognition
    diar   speaker diarization
    sep    source separation
    gen    text/audio conditioned music or sound generation
    tts    text to speech
    clon   voice cloning
    vc     voice conversion
    s2s    speech to speech
    align  forced alignment
    vdes   voice design
    spk    speaker embedding/recognition
    svc    singing voice conversion
    midi   audio-to-symbolic MIDI/event transcription
